hold_text: manager merges after an independent review; order-control code of a prop platform adapter (checklist row PROP-TERM; manager dispatch 2026-09-29, lane session_01DRfUhAJ93tkSDcfRj7nmpu). No account exists on the proprietary terminal; every armed call now refuses before its final click.
why: Brings the merged breakout_terminal adapter (#13658) to the DXtrade safety posture on main. (1) The close-control selection is #14216's hardened CLOSE_ROW_JS with this terminal's header vocabulary: exactly one row, its side/size/entry must match, the row's last control must be the only close-type one, no reverse/modify/close-all word on it or any ancestor, and it must not be nested in another pressable, must sit inside its row and away from a canvas. (2) Refusal text and control markup pass _mask_public_text/_mask_controls, so no position id reaches a public log. The probe returns form_text_len, not the raw form text. (3) Armed/disarmed discipline: place_bracket/cancel_order/flatten with arm=True walk the full dry path, then refuse with clicked=False, because the submit, cancel and close confirmations are unmeasured. (4) dxtrade's full read-back (symbol, side, type, values within a tick, bracket legs, controls inside the panel). (5) flatten takes the executor's side/quantity/entry_price keywords; before this, switching platform raised a TypeError in the watched close. (6) The ticket opener no longer includes 'Place Order', which is also the submit's name. (7) dxtrade JS substitutions fail at import instead of silently doing nothing. (8) Read-only dump_tables is added and wired into the probe. Tier-2 by path (src/prop order controls).
